download_source_dataset: download a single source benchmark dataset to a specified data directory with optional force flag
load_source_prompts: load prompts from a downloaded source dataset with optional filtering by required lookup keys
get_lookup_key: get the unique lookup key for a prompt based on its source and metadata fields
merge_prompts: merge downloaded source prompts into a release JSON file and output the complete dataset
run_download_and_merge_cli: run the CLI to download source data and merge prompts into a release JSON file
